_comment: Calibration for the head-mounted Intel RealSense D435 in the Humanoid
Everyday recordings. Intrinsics and depth_to_colour are copied verbatim
Humanoid-Everyday). Depth is stored in the *depth* camera frame -- the
dataset's own example loader deprojects it with the depth intrinsics -- so
the two imagers do not share a projection.
pelvis_to_colour_camera is NOT in the dataset. It was measured here from
the G1 loco_manipulation recordings: the rotation by hand-eye between the
depth-ICP camera trajectory and the odometry orientation (1.4 deg median
residual over 10-frame steps), the z offset from a RANSAC floor plane
(camera 1.209 m above the floor, pelvis 0.718 m by odometry). The forward
offset x is nominal from the G1's head placement, not measured -- it only
affects `--poses odom`, which this demo uses for comparison, not for
Pelvis frame is x forward, y left, z up. The measured rotation is a
forward-looking camera pitched 56.1 deg down, 3.6 deg off centre in yaw,
1.0 deg of roll -- which is why so much of the FOV is floor and tabletop.

h1._pelvis_to_colour_camera_comment: Not measured. The G1 rotation is reused and the height scaled to the H1's taller torso, so `--poses odom` on H1 sequences is indicative only.
